note: Background Image Formatter provides two field formatters that render an image as a CSS background-image instead of an : background_image_formatter (for image fields, extends core ImageFormatter) and background_media_image_formatter (for entity_reference fields targeting media). No configure route (configure=null), no settings form, no permissions, no Drush. Shared formatter settings: image_style, background_image_output_type (inline|css), background_image_selector, background_image_link (bool), background_image_link_custom (tokens when Token enabled). Configured on a field's Manage display; stored in core.entity_view_display... -> content..type + settings. Inline output renders the background_image_formatter_inline theme; css output injects a

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site I want an image field to render as a CSS background-image (on a div) rather than an tag. Which module/formatter does this, and what are its two output modes?
evals.expected_output: Use the Background Image Formatter module and set the image field's Format (Manage display) to 'Background Image' (background_image_formatter). Its background_image_output_type is either 'inline' (a div with a style attribute) or 'css' (a <style> rule injected into the page head).

evals.prompt: What settings does the Background Image formatter expose on a field's Manage display?
evals.expected_output: image_style (image style machine name or empty for original), background_image_output_type (inline|css), background_image_selector (CSS selector), background_image_link (bool, inline only: wrap in a link to the content), and background_image_link_custom (custom link URL, supports tokens when Token is enabled).

evals.prompt: I don't have a plain image field; I have a Media reference field. Can Background Image Formatter use that as a background, and which formatter applies?
evals.expected_output: Yes. Use the background_media_image_formatter, which applies to entity_reference fields whose target type is media; it reads the referenced media entity's thumbnail image and renders it as the background.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, an image field is configured with the Background Image formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and report the CSS selector and the output type (inline or css) it uses.
evals.expected_output: On node.bif_selct the field_bif_hero display uses background_image_formatter with background_image_selector '.bif-eval-hero' and background_image_output_type 'css' (core.entity_view_display.node.bif_selct.default -> content.field_bif_hero.settings).

evals.prompt: On this site a content type has an image field displayed with the Background Image formatter. Inspect the live display config and state which image style it applies and whether it outputs inline or via a CSS rule.
evals.expected_output: On node.bif_stylect the field_bif_style display uses background_image_formatter with image_style 'thumbnail' and background_image_output_type 'inline'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a content type bif_task with an image field field_bif_task. Configure its default view display to use the Background Image formatter, outputting the background as a CSS rule (output type 'css') for the CSS selector `.bif-hero`. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.bif_task.default set the field_bif_task component to type background_image_formatter with settings.background_image_output_type='css' and settings.background_image_selector='.bif-hero' (via Manage display or setComponent(...)->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a content type bif_task2 with an image field field_bif_link. Configure its default view display to use the Background Image formatter with inline output (output type 'inline') and with the background image linked to the content (enable 'Link image to content'). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: On core.entity_view_display.node.bif_task2.default set the field_bif_link component to type background_image_formatter with settings.background_image_output_type='inline' and settings.background_image_link=TRUE.
